design_role: Prospective test following negative and mixed the pilot study outcomes; no promise of superiority.
contrast_information: Known contrast supplied to every method; final labels remain noisy.
step_schedule: base*rate*(1+global_update/256)^(-3/4); no reset, clipping, or normalization during moving SGD
selection: Four development seeds: minimum mean noisy final-label validation error within each family/readout/case. Ties prefer smaller alpha then smaller rate. Choices frozen before confirmation; no seed, rate, alpha or budget extension.
primary_inference: CV minus SGD, SGD-blend, plain-shrink and pilot for C1/parity6/parity9: 12 two-sided paired sign-flip tests, assuming paired-sign symmetry, one Holm family at .05. All sixteen seeds retained. Nominal t15 intervals are not simultaneous.
secondary_scope: MP6, frame/subspace errors, native SGD soft loss and finite-theory checks descriptive. Uniform calibration F=lambda*h gives risk2lambda^2*hard_error, not independent soft improvement.
budget_scope: Every full-budget method uses at most n unique training labels per seed, paired streams, and equal development validation data. Pilot-only uses n/2 labels and is a mechanism control. CV/plain/SGD-blend each search40 rate-alpha candidates; ordinary SGD/pilot search8 rates. Runtime and compute are not asserted equal.
failure_policy: Preserve nonfinite states, mismatches, partial outputs and all adverse/inconclusive outcomes. Do not replace runs or alter source after performance outcome access; an implementation defect requires a documented new protocol/version. No continuation until a desired sign appears.
